verdict.rationale: Portal das Finanças is a government tax and customs service portal, and such a portal could plausibly publish a developer API reference, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows an interactive API reference or runnable examples. The items cover only citizen-facing services (notifications, registration, tax and customs services, outage notices), and the llms.txt probe returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
